281465875.description:
Rock and Mineral Specimen Lot - 15 Pieces
Geological Study Collection
Educational Earth Science Specimens
This collection features 15 varied rock and mineral specimens housed in an organized molded compartmental tray with an exterior textured red storage box. Educational rock and mineral kits of this type were commonly assembled for geology students and hobbyists to study crystal habits, streak, luster, and cleavage.
Items Included:
15 varied geological specimens including sulfur, quartz, fluorite, feldspar, and metallic ore samples
Individual numbered identification stickers affixed to multiple specimens
15-compartment white molded plastic display tray
Two-piece textured maroon red paperboard storage box
Condition:
Natural geological specimens show expected raw crystalline and fractured surfaces. Several specimens retain circular numbered collection labels with minor adhesive aging. Storage box displays light exterior corner rubbing and shelf wear, remaining structurally sound.
Thank you for all of your support!

Duk-It (McDonald Products Corp.)
Solid American Walnut with Brass Ferrule
Mid-Century Modern, Six-Pipe Capacity
This mid-century pipe rack was produced by McDonald Products Corp. of Buffalo, New York, under their renowned Duk-It line of executive desk accessories and tobacciana. Crafted from genuine American walnut, the stand showcases clean lines and a central tapered pedestal accented with a brass ferrule, reflecting classic mid-century functional design.
Solid American walnut construction with rich natural wood grain throughout
Accommodates up to six smoking pipes with carved base rests and circular top cutouts
Brown felt protective base retains original Duk-It and Genuine American Walnut foil labels
Measures 6 inches long by 6 inches wide and 5.5 inches tall
Condition:
Good vintage condition with solid structural integrity and a stable base. Surface shows scattered light cosmetic wear, including several small white spots and blemishes on the upper surface of the base plate consistent with prior use. The brass collar retains age-appropriate patina, and the bottom felt and foil maker labels remain intact.

279369720.description:
Mineral Identification Collection Kit
Geological Specimen Study Set
8 Natural Mineral Samples in Display Box
8" x 6" x 2"
Numbered Collection
This professional mineral identification kit is an essential resource for geological education and scientific observation. The collection consists of eight distinct natural mineral specimens, including recognizable samples such as crystalline quartz, pink feldspar, and metallic pyrite. Each sample is individually numbered, allowing for systematic classification and study of physical properties such as luster, crystal habit, and cleavage.
Features 8 high-quality natural specimens housed in a 9-compartment white plastic organizer
Housed in a durable red textured storage case with a protective foam-lined interior lid
Provides a hands-on learning experience for students, hobbyists, and amateur geologists
Condition:
Very good pre-owned condition. The kit contains 8 specimens total, leaving one slot in the tray currently vacant. The minerals are well-preserved and stable. The storage box remains structurally sound with light age-appropriate wear to the exterior finish.
